**Play in your browser:** https://maxcwolf.github.io/pressure-point/

**Or download:** `mac-arm64.dmg` for Apple silicon Macs, `mac-x64.dmg` for Intel Macs, `win-x64.exe` for Windows.

First launch: on macOS, right-click the app and choose **Open**. On Windows, click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
